item.body:
About us

Property Media Japan specialises in Real Estate Photography, Videography, Aerial Photography, Floor-plans and Virtual Staging. Previously based in Queenstown New Zealand, we are now operating in Niseko, Hokkaido Japan.


This immaculate property, nestled in the tranquil surroundings of Arrowtown, offers an exceptional blend of comfort, style, and scenic beauty. Built on a generously sized lot, this home features a well-designed floor plan spread over a spacious area that perfectly accommodates family living and entertaining needs.

Key Features:

  • 4 Bedrooms & 3 Bathrooms: Ample space for family and guests, each room finished with attention to detail, providing a cozy and inviting atmosphere.

  • 2 Living Rooms: Designed for relaxation and family gatherings, each living space offers a unique ambiance—one cozy with a stone fireplace and another bright and airy with direct access to outdoor views.

  • Modern Kitchen & Dining: Equipped with high-end appliances and ample counter space, perfect for the home chef. The adjacent dining area, with its scenic windows, offers a picturesque setting for every meal.

  • Dedicated Office Space: A quiet room filled with natural light, ideal for remote work or creative endeavors.

  • Outdoor Living: A stunning wooden deck overlooks the lush green landscape and majestic mountain backdrop, featuring a pristine pool for leisure and recreation.

  • 2-Car Garage: Large and accommodating, providing additional storage space and convenience.

  • Additional Amenities: Includes a beautifully appointed bathroom with modern fixtures and a utility area for optimal home management.

Located in the heart of Arrowtown, this property is just moments away from local amenities, offering a perfect blend of privacy and accessibility. Experience the ultimate in comfort and luxury in a home that offers it all.

This home is a perfect haven for those looking to enjoy the serene landscapes of Japan while enjoying modern comforts and conveniences. Whether it's cozy winter evenings by the fire or sunny days lounging by the pool, 18 Stafford St. is your gateway to a privileged lifestyle.
